<p align="center"><strong>Discovery - the ward was renewed every Halloween.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern</small></p>


<p align="center">Twelve scratches mark the underside of the lantern. Each is dated October 31, one year apart. The thirteenth was never finished.</p>

<p align="center">Elias wrote beside them: &quot;The light does not kill her. It shuts the door. Someone must keep it burning when the boundary thins again.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">You tighten the last screw. From the front of the house comes a single knock.</p>
